The structure of Zr6Nb4Co2 (reduced formula Zr3Nb2Co) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mcm (No. 143), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Nb each adopt 10-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, while Zr has 16 geometric neighbors (10 Co, 6 Nb). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Co and Nb 10-vertex polyhedra and between Zr 16-vertex polyhedra, plus corner-sharing between Co and Zr polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
